# Gaurav Lahoti

> Cloud & AI-Native Architect based in Gurugram, India. I spent 11+ years making enterprise systems talk to each other on GCP and AWS. Now I build production AI agents that plug into those systems, with Google ADK, LangGraph and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

This site is built to be read by agents as well as people. It registers WebMCP tools (search_site, get_profile, list_work, go_to, draft_note_to_gaurav), so an agent in the browser can call typed functions instead of scraping the page. It also runs a live chat agent, Atlas, that answers questions about my work.

## Work

- [Selected Work](https://gauravlahoti.dev/selected-work/): three enterprise AI systems, each told as use case, solution and efficiency gained. A self-service assistant, touchless invoice processing, and a self-learning agent team for cloud errors.
- [Live Agents](https://gauravlahoti.dev/live-agents/): agents running in production. Atlas (chat), Pulse (a scheduled ambient agent), ErrorLens, Agentic RAG and Agentic Harness.

## AI Lab: interactive explainers

- [MCP Lab](https://gauravlahoti.dev/ai-labs/mcp-lab/): the Model Context Protocol, explained in six clickable acts.
- [Engineering Loops](https://gauravlahoti.dev/ai-labs/engineering-loops/): prompt, context, harness and loop engineering, drawn as layers around one model.
- [Agent-Ready Web](https://gauravlahoti.dev/ai-labs/agent-ready/): WebMCP on this site. A live tool registry and a console that runs each tool.
- [All labs](https://gauravlahoti.dev/ai-labs/)
